system.description: This devotional seal to Sigmar is formed from a blob of wax, impressed with a holy sigil, and used to attach a prayer strip to the person to be so marked. This large and impressive seal is not currently affixed to anything, but meant to be carried as a reminder of Sigmar’s teachings and ward off dark powers. Encumbrance: 1 The bearer of this seal may add {Df} to checks to resist corruption or disease. When spending fortune points on such checks, the bearer may add {Df} to the dice pool rather
